info.text:
Show it, then let them try it. A simple pattern for teaching any skill.
Training built around practice: https://ka-performancefl.com/training/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=2026-10-21

1. Watch one done. Show a finished example, and point out why each part is there.
2. Do one with hints. Let them build one with the pieces and the labels in front of them.
3. Do one alone. Give them a new problem, with no pieces and no labels.

Every screen in this reel comes from our sample course "The RFI that gets answered": a finished request explored part by part, then a request built from fragments and labeled fields, then a different issue and an empty box.

That's how we build a module: objectives, teaching, practice, check. Try our six sample courses on the site, or call Alex at 904-210-1071.

The music is AI generated.

#eLearning #InstructionalDesign #CorporateTraining
